title: corelle embossed design dessert or bread and butter plates
text: corelle embossed design dessert or bread and butter plates. This are quite lovely for Corelle - however, very single plate had a horrible, sticky sticker on the bottom.  You will need a razor AND a goo remover.  Eh.  Was not thrilled with that.  But the plates are lovely.  They are what I would call a warm white, NOT a bright white.  I was worried the embossing would make them less likely to stack nicely, but they still do.  These were a gift so I purchased the felts to go between each one.  Even though they are tough Corelle, you want to protect them.  Each plate is just under 7" round.  Smooth edges, as with all Corelle and I am hoping they will be as tough as most Corelle.
